reply_text:
I replied to Pree in the DM: on 14 October they told me their Tansleigh Packaging paperwork cutoff is 21 October from now on.

That answer came from their own message in this DM, not from GBrain. The private fact I saved on 14 October didn't come back from GBrain. I looked it up by Pree's record twice, once with the question and once without, and both returned nothing, even though the save had reported success. Most likely private facts can only be read in the session that saved them. That means "remember this for me" requests saved privately in GBrain may not be retrievable later, so for now the DM history is the dependable record.
